category5.design: The OSS-Fuzz target (cryptofuzz-relic) always signs with hash = 1, so the changed hash == 0 branch has no harness and relic has no CLI; the PoV is a C program linked with the build's librelic_s.a (the test_cp link line), judged by the program crash rule (an ASan report from relic_cp_ecdsa.c).
